notes.title: 50% off? 75% off?! You betcha!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44264647/60cc34c8cf76f354d889054623ce6273afc25db7.gif[/img]

We got the nod from the boss. The rumours are true. A chilling breeze, sweeps through town. Yes. Cape Hideous, by Melbourne artist and indie game dev Jake Clover, is 75% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3187550/Cape_Hideous

You may also be interested to know, that Nonsense Machine's largest and most ambitious project to date, Dryft City Kyngs, is also 50% off. Hey don't look at me, I'm just a little bird!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2136770/Dryft_City_Kyngs

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3052350/Dryft_City_Kyngs_Soundtrack/

Oh? You're still here? Are these offerings not enough to entice you to part with your gold? Well. I guess we'll go our separate ways then OH WAIT - every other Nonsense Machine game and soundtrack under the sun is also 50% off! See for yourself, below.

[previewyoutube=veqwnB8rw9s;full][/previewyoutube]

For your convenience, we have created some digital teleportation portals leading to products you may like to purchase. HEY. MY DEALS ARE DOWN HERE.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928450/dweeMIXED_Thwee_Pack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1314980/Mealmates/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/855530/New_Ice_York/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/564810/Ticket/

"Have a good one."
~dweedes, 2025
